text: Riches seem in so many cases to smother the manliness of their possessors, and their sympathies become, not so much narrowed as, so to speak, stratified: they are reserved for the sufferings of their own class, and also the woes of those above them.
author: Peter Kropotkin
speaker: Samuel Plimsoll
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter VIII, Mutual Aid Amongst Ourselves (continued)
